documents.sub: Subtract the second number from the first number; integer difference with borrow.
documents.xor: Bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) of two integers; bits differ.
documents.buffer.new: Allocate, create a new byte array in memory with the requested size.
documents.buffer.length: Measure buffer size, count how many bytes a memory buffer contains.
documents.buffer.get: Read, retrieve, fetch one byte from a memory buffer at a position or offset.
documents.buffer.set: Write, replace, update one byte in a memory buffer at a position or offset.
documents.file.read: Read, load file contents from disk into memory, returning a byte buffer.
documents.file.write: Write, save buffer contents from memory to a disk file; return bytes written.
documents.fill: Repeat indexed operations over the bytes in a file buffer. Fill all bytes of a file with the same supplied value.
documents.map: Repeat indexed operations over the bytes in a file buffer. Transform every byte of a file using bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) of byte from file bytes read from input path and input value.
documents.guarded_map: Conditionally execute when a flag is nonzero; otherwise skip. Repeat indexed operations over the bytes in a file buffer. Transform every byte of a file using bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) of byte from file bytes read from input path and input value.
documents.pair_map: Apply operations to two separate files. Repeat indexed operations over the bytes in a file buffer. Transform every byte of a file using bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) of byte from file bytes read from input path and input value.

evaluation_protocol.heldout: 24 diagnostic requests inspected during iteration, no longer independent holdout
